5.5 Each Network Is a Destination of Its Own

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-swipe-after-chip: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-swipe-after-chip: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-swipe-after-chip: 5.3 says that when the entry mode comes from the terminal's configuration ('code 05 plus the PIN digit: 051') and the card fields come from what actually happened, the swiped fallback 'leaves claiming a chip read and carrying no chip data'; 'a stripe read carries track 2 in field 35' supplies the track 2.
recorded.prompt:q-forum-layout: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-forum-layout: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-forum-layout: 5.4 says a private field filled 'from a blog post, from memory or from the other network's layout is either rejected ... or accepted and misread', and 'each network decides what goes inside'; treating a forum post like a blog post is a short inference.
recorded.prompt:q-other-link-up: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-other-link-up: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-other-link-up: 5.5 says explicitly that 'the router reports at once that the Mastercard host is unavailable, and since it sent nothing, there is nothing to reverse.'
recorded.prompt:q-wrong-frame: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-wrong-frame: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-wrong-frame: 5.5.1 says VAPChannel puts two zero bytes and a 22-byte BASE I header after its length, and a host that expects only the length (as NACChannel does) reads the zero bytes and the header as the start of the message and can't unpack it, which is option c.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-swipe-after-chip:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-swipe-after-chip:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-swipe-after-chip:b: 5.3 says the swiped fallback carries 'no chip data', and a stripe read carries only track 2, so field 55 is not present.
recorded.prompt:q-swipe-after-chip:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-swipe-after-chip:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-swipe-after-chip:c: 5.3 says the fallback 'leaves claiming a chip read', so field 22 stays 051; that jPOS does not correct it is inferred from this outcome, because the page never says outright that jPOS doesn't rewrite fields.
recorded.prompt:q-swipe-after-chip:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-swipe-after-chip:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-swipe-after-chip:d: Inference: 5.3 says the contradictory request 'leaves', so it packs; the page never says a packager doesn't check whether fields agree (5.2.2 only shows it checking length).
recorded.prompt:q-forum-layout:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-forum-layout:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-forum-layout:a: 5.4 says explicitly that 'ISO 8583 gives each a number and a maximum length and nothing else, so each network decides what goes inside.'
recorded.prompt:q-forum-layout:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-forum-layout:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-forum-layout:b: Inference: 5.4 names only two outcomes, rejected or accepted and misread, which rules out 'little risk', but the page never says outright that a host doesn't skip unknown subelements.
recorded.prompt:q-forum-layout:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-forum-layout:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-forum-layout:d: Inference: 5.4 says ISO defines only a number and a maximum length, so there is no ISO layout to compare against, and it names 'accepted and misread' as an outcome, not a log warning.
recorded.prompt:q-other-link-up:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-other-link-up:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-other-link-up:a: 5.5 says explicitly that 'A QMUX doesn't route: it writes every request to its one out queue, which leads to one link.'
recorded.prompt:q-other-link-up:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-other-link-up:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-other-link-up:b: 5.5 says 'A real Visa host receives a Mastercard card with Mastercard's acquirer ID and can at best decline it', so it does not pass the card on.
recorded.prompt:q-other-link-up:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-other-link-up:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-other-link-up:d: 5.5 says explicitly that 'since it sent nothing, there is nothing to reverse.'
recorded.prompt:q-wrong-frame:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-wrong-frame:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-wrong-frame:a: 5.5.1 says the same host 'can't unpack' the message because the zero bytes and header follow the length, so the claim that it unpacks normally is refuted.
recorded.prompt:q-wrong-frame:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-wrong-frame:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-wrong-frame:b: 5.5.1 says such a host reads the zero bytes and header as the start of the message instead of skipping them, which refutes the claim that a host skips a header it didn't ask for.
recorded.prompt:q-wrong-frame:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-wrong-frame:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-wrong-frame:d: 5.5.1 says VAPChannel writes 'a 2-byte length' (the captured 00320000), and the 5.7 channel table repeats '2-byte length', so the claim of four ASCII digits is refuted.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
